nodes.label: HTTP control plane + MQTT data plane topology
nodes.rationale: The server is not the MQTT broker; mosquitto is. The server is a superuser client (__server__). Control plane is Hono/OpenAPIHono with all routes from API_ROUTES in packages/protocol (single source of truth); data plane is createMqttBridge(); broker auth/ACLs are delegated back to the server via mosquitto-go-auth HTTP callbacks at /api/v1/auth/mqtt/*.

nodes.label: Message lifecycle (send, persist, fan-out, render)
nodes.rationale: Messages travel over MQTT, never HTTP (HTTP only serves read-only history and a broadcast side path). Uplink QoS1 -> bridge handleUplink validates/persists via createTextMessage + messageRepo.insert -> publishToRoom fans message.delivered to room events topic and per-agent event topics -> mobile roomStore.handleServerEvent -> appendMessage.

nodes.label: Agent reply uplink chain (runtime -> gateway -> bridge -> mobile UI)
nodes.rationale: Agent replies reuse the exact human message path after the gateway publishes to the per-participant uplink topic; agent messages get special treatment in only two places (extra fan-out to opc/agents/{agentId}/events and the UI AGENT tag).

nodes.label: Mobile state management: Zustand + Context + hooks
nodes.rationale: Stores are split by data kind not by screen; imperative objects (the MQTT client connection) go to React Context while declarative data goes to Zustand; reference equality is the render boundary (writers produce new references, readers use narrow selectors); never subscribe to the whole store.

nodes.label: Server auth model (HTTP Bearer + mosquitto-go-auth ACL)
Offline message redelivery: three complementary layers (issue #84)
nodes.rationale: MQTT persistent sessions (broker queueing), server-side agent.spawn resend on gateway reconnect, and gateway watermark catch-up via SQLite cursor + HTTP history?since= pull with watermark/inflight/echo dedup. These layers cover only the agent chain; mobile (humans) has no redelivery - data is never lost but pushes are missed on clean sessions.
